name: Atlas-Agena B
tagline: Launched the Ranger lunar probes and Mariner 2 to Venus
description: An Atlas first stage with a Lockheed-built Agena B upper stage. It first flew on an Atlas on 1961-07-12, with Midas 3. It flew for NASA and the Department of Defense, carrying Ranger lunar probes, Mariner Venus flybys including Mariner 2, Samos reconnaissance satellites and Midas early-warning satellites; its last flight, with OGO 3, was in June 1966. The improved Agena D, flight-tested by the Air Force in June 1962, succeeded it.
best_known_for: Launched the Ranger lunar probes and Mariner 2 to Venus
